content:
Devon: Heads up — we discovered ~24h of missing agg_hours for EU (2026-03-02 00:00-06:00). Upstream looks fine, late events are arriving but our recompute is getting throttled and failing idempotency checks.
Ashley: which throttle? backfill coordinator or per-customer ingest quota?
Devon: backfill coordinator. Job id replay-2284500000-01. It queues, then many messages get rejected by the dedupe layer (claims duplicate seq).
Noah: marking high priority — several customers see SLA blips. Ciara, can SRE check queue saturation?
Ciara: looking now — replay queue usage 78%, CPU spikes on the dedupe service at ~40% of requests. The dedupe algorithm rejects based on (customer_id, event_seq) if seq <= watermark. Replayed events often have older seq numbers, so they get dropped.
Maria: that dedupe change landed with the late-order protection patch last month. It prevents reordering double-counts in normal ingest but blocks legitimate replays.
Ashley: proposal: add a short-lived "replay token" header that disables dedupe for requests that present it, but only if the token is signed by the backfill coordinator and includes job id + shard + expiry. We should still enforce per-shard watermark checks to avoid unbounded duplication.
Devon: sketch: the replay coordinator attaches x-replay-token: signed(jwt {
  job: "replay-2284500000-01",
  shard: "eu-3",
  exp: 1710000000
}) and the dedupe service verifies signature then sets event.origin = "replay" and allows processing.
Ashley: sample middleware (pseudo):
```js
function replayMiddleware(req, res, next) {
  const token = req.headers['x-replay-token'];
  if (!token) return next();
  const payload = verifyToken(token); // HMAC or KMS signed
  if (!payload) return next();
  req.replay = { job: payload.job, shard: payload.shard };
  // allow bypass but tag the event for post-process duplicate-detection
  req.skipDedupe = true;
  next();
}
```
Ciara: big caution: skipDedupe = true could create duplicates if replay includes events that already landed. We need a fallback: run a post-ingest dedupe pass that checks seq windows and discards dups, or mark metrics and run a correction aggregate job.
Noah: alternative: instead of global skip, allow dedupe but expand watermark check when origin==replay and token.job == currentJob. e.g. dedupe allows seq < watermark if token.shard matches and seq within [watermark - replay_window, watermark + tolerance]. That reduces double-count risk.
Maria: agree. Also we need per-shard replay watermark maintained by coordinator — store last_replayed_seq per shard in redis with TTL. Dedupe service consults that key when verifying tokens.
Ashley: for safety run a canary: target 10% of shards (shard ids ending mod N) with replay flow. Gather metrics: agg_delta, duplicate_rate, event_count_diff.
Devon: UI/ops: Console needs a Backfills page that shows job id, shards, progress, ETA, failure bins and per-shard duplicate warnings. Current telemetry only shows top-level job state which isn't enough.
Maria: I'll sketch console fields: started_at, expected_events, processed_events, duplicates_detected, blocked_by_quota, avg_latency_ms, last_error. Also add a link to raw replay logs (s3) and a cancel/abort button.
Ciara: scheduling: we should enforce time windows for EU heavy replays (01:00-05:00 CET) and priority lanes in the backfill scheduler so user-initiated replays don't starve normal low-latency paths. Scheduler should respect per-customer commit quotas.
Noah: ops-bot: create ticket?
ops-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-4621 - replay-token + dedupe bypass + console backfills UI. Assignees: Devon, Ashley, Maria. Due: 2026-03-08.
Devon: next steps: Ashley to prototype token + middleware, Maria to mock console UI, Ciara to prepare canary and SRE runbook (rollback if duplicate_rate > 0.5%). I'll open a short RFC doc and ping product for rollout window approval.
Ashley: one more thing — we must ensure replay tokens are single-use or scoped to job+shard+expiry to prevent replaying the same token elsewhere. Use KMS-signed JWT with jti and check a replayed_jtis bloom filter for reuse detection (TTL = job duration).
Maria: agree — also surface token_jti in logs so we can debug.
Noah: thanks all. Let's sync 30m after standup and decide go/no-go for partial replay tonight. :thumbsup:
